titulo: Trump backs Infantino as 3 soccer federations accuse FIFA president of 'deception' in open letter
cuerpo: U.S. President Donald Trump said in a social media post on Monday that it would be a 'terrible mistake' for FIFA to replace its embattled president, Gianni Infantino. This follows an open letter issued earlier Monday by three soccer federations attacking Infantino over his conduct during the proposed sale of a stake in the commercial rights to the World Cup.
